data.title: 爱宕 · 客厅沙发的微醺依恋
data.description: 暖黄色壁灯照耀的温馨客厅内，爱宕侧坐在绒布长沙发角。围裙系带微松，内衬针织衫勾勒出极其丰满曼妙的轮廓。头顶毛茸茸的黑色犬耳羞怯地伏在发丝间，她双手捧着一杯温牛奶，微红的双颊带着如大姐姐般的极尽温柔与让人心跳加速的包容神采。
data.location: cozy private living room couch by lamplight
data.action: sitting comfortably on plush sofa holding warm cup, apron tied loosely over knit top, black dog ears gently drooped, sweet blushing smile full of pampering affection
data.lighting: warm cozy indoor lamplight casting golden gradients across living room
data.mood: overwhelming maternal warmth, sweet domestic adoration
data.promptProse: Relaxing on a plush living room couch, Atago wears a cozy knit top with an apron loosely tied. Her black dog ears droop softly with affection as she holds a warm mug, smiling with deep, pampering tenderness.
data.animaCaption: Atago resting on a sofa in an apron with gentle dog ears and an affectionate blush.
